name: agent_bridge_stub
description: Reverse-proxy router for :18765. Routes /v1/reach, /v1/notebooklm, /v1/icarus, /v1/llama, /v1/models to the bridge (:7860); everything else to the webui-managed broker (:18766). The webui's HERMES_AGENT_BRIDGE_ENDPOINT env var is set to tcp://127.0.0.1:18766 in modules/webui/start.ps1 so the broker starts on :18766 instead of the default :18765. See AGENTS.md §0.9.
